tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Places visible to the caller (every active place plus the caller's own in any status), optionally within a viewport and filtered by category / text. Newest first. The map and the list call this same action.
tools.sql: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.owner_name, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.address, p.lat, p.lng, p.status, p.image_key, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p WHERE (p.status = 'active' OR p.owner_id = :__user_id) AND (:category_id IS NULL OR p.category_id = :category_id) AND (:q IS NULL OR p.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR p.description LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR p.address LIKE '%' || :q || '%') AND (:south IS NULL OR :north IS NULL OR :west IS NULL OR :east IS NULL OR (p.lat BETWEEN :south AND :north AND ((:west <= :east AND p.lng BETWEEN :west AND :east) OR (:west > :east AND (p.lng >= :west OR p.lng <= :east))))) ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: count_places
tools.description: How many places match the same visibility, filters and viewport as list_places (the list shows the total; the map shows the page).
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM places p WHERE (p.status = 'active' OR p.owner_id = :__user_id) AND (:category_id IS NULL OR p.category_id = :category_id) AND (:q IS NULL OR p.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR p.description LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR p.address LIKE '%' || :q || '%') AND (:south IS NULL OR :north IS NULL OR :west IS NULL OR :east IS NULL OR (p.lat BETWEEN :south AND :north AND ((:west <= :east AND p.lng BETWEEN :west AND :east) OR (:west > :east AND (p.lng >= :west OR p.lng <= :east))))) LIMIT 1

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: One place, if the caller may see it (active, or their own).
tools.sql: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.owner_name, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.address, p.lat, p.lng, p.status, p.image_key, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p WHERE p.id = :id AND (p.status = 'active' OR p.owner_id = :__user_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_places
tools.description: The caller's own places in every status, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.owner_name, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.address, p.lat, p.lng, p.status, p.image_key, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p WHERE p.owner_id = :__user_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_place
tools.description: Add a place owned by the caller. Idempotent by client id. Coordinates must be on the globe; the category, if given, must exist.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO places (id, owner_id, owner_name, category_id, name, description, address, lat, lng, status, image_key, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, :owner_name, :category_id, :name, :description, :address, :lat, :lng, 'active', :image_key, :__now, :__now WHERE :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND (:category_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.id = :category_id))

owner_name.description: Display name shown on the record

image_key.description: Public storage key of a photo

tools.name: update_place
tools.description: Edit one of the caller's own places.
tools.sql: UPDATE places SET category_id = :category_id, name = :name, description = :description, address = :address, lat = :lat, lng = :lng, image_key = :image_key, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND (:category_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.id = :category_id))

tools.name: set_place_status
tools.description: Hide or re-activate one of the caller's own places (a hidden place is visible only to its owner).
tools.sql: UPDATE places SET status = :status, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND :status IN ('active', 'hidden')

tools.name: delete_place
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's own places.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM places WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories, in display order — the shared catalogue behind the filter bar.
tools.sql: SELECT id, name, color, icon, sort_order FROM categories ORDER BY sort_order, name LIMIT 200

caller_unscoped.reason: shared category catalogue: no per-user or per-tenant row data

tools.name: category_stats
tools.description: Active places per category, for the filter bar and the admin table.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS active_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN places p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.name LIMIT 200

caller_unscoped.reason: aggregate counts per category over active (public-to-members) places; no row data

tools.name: admin_create_category
tools.description: Create a category (app role admin or editor). Idempotent by client id.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO categories (id, name, color, icon, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :name, :color, :icon, :sort_order, :__now, :__now)

caller_unscoped.reason: app-role-gated management of the shared category catalogue

tools.name: admin_update_category
tools.description: Edit a category (app role admin or editor).
tools.sql: UPDATE categories SET name = :name, color = :color, icon = :icon, sort_order = :sort_order, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id

caller_unscoped.reason: app-role-gated management of the shared category catalogue

tools.name: admin_delete_category
tools.description: Delete a category (app role admin or editor); places in it keep their record with no category.
statements: UPDATE places SET category_id = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE category_id = :id

caller_unscoped.reason: app-role-gated management of the shared category catalogue

tools.name: admin_list_places
tools.description: Every place in every status, for the management table (app role admin or editor).
tools.sql: SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.owner_name, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.address, p.lat, p.lng, p.status, p.image_key, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM places p WHERE (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status) AND (:category_id IS NULL OR p.category_id = :category_id) AND (:q IS NULL OR p.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR p.owner_name LIKE '%' || :q || '%') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 500

caller_unscoped.reason: app-role-gated management table over all records

tools.name: admin_set_place_status
tools.description: Hide or re-activate any place (app role admin or editor).
tools.sql: UPDATE places SET status = :status, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND :status IN ('active', 'hidden')

tools.name: admin_update_place
tools.description: Edit any place's category, name, description or address (app role admin or editor).
tools.sql: UPDATE places SET category_id = :category_id, name = :name, description = :description, address = :address, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (:category_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.id = :category_id))

tools.name: admin_delete_place
tools.description: Delete any place (app role admin or editor).
